description: Official Qualys product page for Vulnerability Management, Detection and Response, covering product overview, key capabilities, and business outcomes of using VMDR.
Qualys LMS self-paced course providing in-depth coverage of all Qualys sensor types including Local Scanner Appliances, External Scanners, and Cloud Agents.
Qualys documentation listing all third-party password vaults currently supported for integration with Qualys authentication records.
Official Qualys documentation for managing Cloud Agents, covering the Agents tab, configuration profiles, module activation, on-demand scans, and agent management actions.

Qualys Community blog post explaining Unified Vulnerability View and how unauthenticated scans and Cloud Agent scans are merged into a single asset record using the Agentless Tracking Identifier and Agent Correlation Identifier.
Lab simulation walking through the process of configuring Asset Tracking and Data Merging settings in VMDR to enable Unified Vulnerability View.
Video demonstration showing how asset merging works in practice, combining scan and Cloud Agent data into a single unified asset record.
Video covering troubleshooting steps for common asset merging issues in VMDR, including cases where detections fail to consolidate into a single asset record.
Qualys documentation on Software Composition Analysis (SwCA) capabilities in the Cloud Agent, covering detection and management of open-source software supply chain vulnerabilities.

Qualys documentation listing key QIDs related to Windows authentication status in scan results, including successful and failed authentication indicators for building dashboard widgets and monitoring scan performance.
Qualys blog article explaining the Subscription Health dashboard and how to use it to optimize deployments, track scan and authentication failures, identify stale hosts, and improve data cleanliness.
Harvard Business Review article cited in the modern security strategy context, noting that 89% of large companies globally have a digital and AI transformation underway.
SEC press release announcing rules requiring public companies to disclose material cybersecurity incidents and their cybersecurity risk management practices.
Reference site for the Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA), the EU regulation demanding cybersecurity risk management transparency from financial entities.
NACD Directors Handbook on Cyber Risk Oversight, covering how corporate leaders now own cyber risk as a strategic enterprise risk.
Qualys blog article reviewing the 2023 threat landscape, explaining that less than 1% of vulnerabilities contributed to the highest risk and were routinely exploited in the wild.
Qualys blog deep dive into how TruRisk is calculated, including the role of CVSS, threat intelligence, exploit code maturity, and business context in producing a risk score.
Qualys Support Portal landing page for documentation, training, community forums, and managing support cases.
Article explaining all the ways to interact with Qualys Support, including calling, chatting, and opening cases.
Document detailing what information to provide to Qualys Support when opening cases to drive faster resolution.
Central location for all Qualys product documentation.
Qualys Systems Status page showing the operational status, maintenance windows, upgrades, and outages for each Qualys platform.
Tool to identify which Qualys platform your organization is using.
Qualys Community page to browse, filter by detection status, or search by CVE to get visibility into upcoming and new vulnerability detections (QIDs) for all severities.
Article walking through how to log a feature request for new vulnerability detections in Qualys.

Qualys Cloud Agent Platform Availability Matrix: currently supported Cloud Agent versions, operating systems, and Qualys app modules; also referenced for the Agent versions that support On-Demand Scans.
Qualys documentation hub for Cloud Agents, including the latest Cloud Agent install guides.
Qualys platform identification resource, including the most updated Cloud Agent Server and CDN URL list and how to identify your Qualys Platform.
Qualys Cloud Agent for Windows Installation Guide, covering installer components, MSI extraction, install commands, and AV/EDR/HIPS allow-listing.
Qualys support article with a detailed walkthrough for deploying Cloud Agent via Microsoft SCCM.
Qualys support article with a detailed walkthrough for deploying Cloud Agent via Microsoft Intune.
Microsoft Intune documentation on Win32 app management, referenced for detailed Intune-based Cloud Agent deployment.

IORAD interactive lab tutorial: Installing Cloud Agent (create Activation Key, add tag, select VM and SCA modules, install on Windows, verify process/log/Host ID/registration, view Asset Details Agent Summary).

Qualys blog article in the Performance Tuning Series covering Cloud Agent Configuration Profile best practices, including CPU Limit and CPU Throttle tuning recommendations.

IORAD interactive lab tutorial: Configuration Profile & Performance Settings (create a Configuration Profile via the wizard, assign Agents with Tags, verify scan settings, enable the PM app, enable Agent Scan Merge, set a reduced activity period, customize a low-performance setting, verify Configuration Profile order).
IORAD interactive lab tutorial: Launch On-Demand Scan (edit the Windows registry to launch a VM On-Demand Scan, and initiate an On-Demand Scan from the Qualys Platform).
Cloud Agent Platform Availability Matrix, end-of-support section: identify EOL/EOS Agent versions when monitoring version distribution against the AVC dashboard.
Cloud Agent Platform Availability Matrix, Feature Dependency section: confirm which operating systems and Agent versions support the CAPS module.

IORAD interactive lab tutorial: Cloud Agent Passive Sensor (verify the Data Upload Interval and set a domain in the CAPS Configuration, activate the CAPS module for an Agent, verify Unmanaged discoveries in the CSAM Inventory, confirm the Agent details that made the discovery).

IORAD interactive lab tutorial: Activating & Configuring SwCA (run CSAM query to check for SwCA ideal candidates, activate the SwCA module, create custom Windows and Linux Scan Profiles, assign a SwCA profile manually, verify SwCA vulnerability findings in View Asset Details).
Backup download link for the Agent-centric Unified Dashboards ZIP (Distribution and Last-24-hours dashboards) that can be imported into CSAM or VMDR for Cloud Agent health monitoring.
Backup SharePoint link to download the Cloud Agent-centric Unified Dashboards (Distribution and Last-24-hours) for import into CSAM or VMDR.

IORAD interactive lab tutorial: Monitoring Agents and Asset Details (view Asset Details including System Information and Agent Summary, explore the built-in Cloud Agent Dashboard, and use an imported Agent Monitoring Dashboard in CSAM with check-in and full-scan widgets and their underlying queries).

IORAD interactive lab tutorial: Deactivate Modules and Uninstall Agents (deactivate the Policy Compliance module via Deactivate Agent, bulk-uninstall three selected Agents, and create a CSAM Asset Purge Rule with lastCheckedIn OLDER THAN 90 days that uninstalls returning agents and runs daily).
Qualys Support video library filtered to Cloud Agent, including the Agent troubleshooting video series referenced for resolving Agent issues.
Qualys support article on setting the PowerShell execution policy to RemoteSigned, a prerequisite for enabling Remote Log Collection for Qualys Support.
Cloud Agent self-paced course self-assessment quiz (Microsoft Forms).
Request page for a full-featured 30-day Qualys trial account.
